t: For purchasing and supplying uniforms; the purchase, maintenance, and repair of police motor vehicles, including two-way police radio equipment; contingent expenses, including $25 per month for extra services performed for the Capitol Police Board by such member of the staff of the Sergeant at Arms of the Senate or the House, as may be designated by the Chairman of the Board; $95,500.

fable.w: This is an appropriation for Capitol Police uniforms, vehicles, and contingent expenses. The tempting reading is that the reference to a "Board" signals an advisory body, but the Capitol Police Board is made up of congressional officers, and the person designated is a staff member of the Sergeant at Arms, so everyone involved is inside the federal government. No outside party is consulted on, or given a right to challenge, any federal decision.
fable.s: extra services performed for the Capitol Police Board by such member of the staff of the Sergeant at Arms of the Senate or the House, as may be designated by the Chairman of the Board

qwen_block.w: This section is an appropriation clause authorizing funds for specific operational expenses such as uniforms, vehicles, and staff services. It does not establish any process for consulting with or coordinating with parties outside the federal government before making a decision. The mention of the 'Capitol Police Board' and the 'Sergeant at Arms' refers to internal government entities and employees, not external participants.
